# THE ART OF AROMA

> Haute Parfumerie & Sacred Botanical Incense Sanctuary from Awaji Island and Kyoto, Japan.

## Overview
Rooted in centuries of Japanese Koh-do tradition, THE ART OF AROMA crafts artisanal, natural incense sticks extruded exclusively from wild-harvested woods, sacred resins, and natural Tabu-no-ki bark without toxic accelerants, synthetic binders, or petroleum dyes.

## Formulations in Orbit
- **Formulation 01: Kyara Woods** ($84 USD): 30-Year Aged Kyara, Fossilized Amber, Temple Frankincense, Cedar Bark. 45-minute contemplative burn.
- **Formulation 02: Hinoki Mist** ($72 USD): Sacred White Hinoki, Wet Mountain Granite, Kyoto Moss, Wild Vetiver. 45-minute contemplative burn.
- **Formulation 03: Sumi & Shiso** ($76 USD): Roasted Bancha Tea, Sumi Ink Soot, Charred Pine, Wet Red Shiso Earth. 45-minute contemplative burn.
- **Formulation 04: Byakudan Sandalwood** ($80 USD): Vintage Mysore Sandalwood, Florentine Orris, Madagascar Tonka, Silk Ash. 50-minute contemplative burn.

## Atelier Concierge
- Locations: Awaji Island & Kyoto, Japan
- Founding: 1876
- Inquiries: curator@theartofaroma.com
